subject.title: [Feature]: Per-session activity state (busy/idle + awaiting_user, awaiting_subagent) via gateway API + WS statechange

question: What canonical public Gateway activity and attention contract should OpenClaw expose for per-session busy, waiting, stale-run, and child-session state?
rationale: The issue defines public Gateway RPC/event semantics and session-state ownership, current main lacks the contract, and open PR candidates differ in scope while leaving attention, stale-run, and child-rollup semantics unsettled.

options.title: Approve Canonical Activity Contract
options.body: Define the `sessions.activity.*` RPC/event schema, persistence boundaries, stale-run handling, and child rollup before merging implementation work.

options.title: Allow Narrow Interim Slices
options.body: Let smaller blocked/stale or Control UI progress work proceed while keeping the broader activity contract open for later.

options.title: Defer Public Activity Surface
options.body: Keep existing diagnostics and `hasActiveRun` signals until maintainers are ready to own a broader Gateway API contract.

recommendation.title: Approve Canonical Activity Contract
recommendation.body: Define the `sessions.activity.*` RPC/event schema, persistence boundaries, stale-run handling, and child rollup before merging implementation work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the live assignee for this canonical activity-contract issue and has recent Gateway/protocol-adjacent history.
